notes: Corrected: the English subject I was assigned to הִשְׂכִּיל and the suffix of עָלַי left unrepresented. The Hebrew verb is 3ms and the ASV's passive drops its agent, so I realizes no person of that verb; it realizes the suffix, which rule 40 places precisely in this recasting, and rule 2 forbids leaving a written morpheme unrepresented while an English word plainly realizing it stands assigned elsewhere. עַל itself remains unrepresented, its relation unstated.
The marginal alternative (Jehovah made me understand in writing by his hand upon me) was read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).
said David is one added run of italic supply and even a second added unit; the ASV's own rendered material stands between them (rules 2, 7).
